author: blu
body: coap-build-request takes a CoapMethod and turns it into a code, which means it can only ever build the request half. A response carries a response code (2.05 Content, 4.04 Not Found) and there is no CoapMethod that spells one, so every builder above could ask and none could answer. This is the same shape the missing parser had: the chapter could only speak. A caller that reached for coap-build-request to build a response got a packet whose code said GET, which a correct client refuses.

author: blu
body: Every function above this line writes a packet. Nothing read one, which meant a device could ask a server for a firmware image and had no way to hear the answer. A block-wise download is a conversation, and this chapter could only talk.
